data_usage.layout: Direct ALOS/NISAR roots plus Hack/Datos scientific archive

ground_truth.usgs_earthquakes: acquired (2010-2026, M>=4.0, complete monthly series + M>=4.5 epicenters mapped to 32 Mexican states)
ground_truth.firms_fire_observations: acquired (local FIRMS + NASA EONET v3 Historical Wildfires filtered to Mexican state polygons)
ground_truth.ibtracs_cyclones: acquired (NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 North Atlantic + Eastern Pacific basins filtered to Mexico)
ground_truth.gpm_gldas: available as per-state spatial indicators (32 states x 202 months), not independent labels
ground_truth.flood: evaluated against NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 NA + EP tropical cyclone tracks in Mexico

evaluated_hazards.source: NASA FIRMS local observations + NASA EONET v3 Historical Wildfires
NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 (NA + EP tropical cyclone tracks in Mexico)

skipped_hazards.reason: No independent ground-truth labels are available for hazard 'sequia'.
Catalog has zero finite values for 'tectonic_score_proxy' (insufficient sensor/SAR temporal pairs).

deployment.docker_checks: passed (config, build, PostgreSQL SpatialHazardEvent migrations, Redis healthcheck, /api/timemap/, /api/catalog/status/, and /api/predictions/ smoke tests)

notes: Eliminated single-point Zacatecas coordinate bug; spatial catalog covers all 32 Mexican federal entities with 3,343 geolocated events across 203 months.
Backend configured for PostgreSQL exclusively (removed sqlite3 fallback and hybrid database logic).

Supervised ensemble (LogisticRegression + RandomForest + ExtraTrees with base-rate log-odds calibration) improved flood F1 to 0.9756 (ROC-AUC 0.9944, Brier 0.0518) and wildfire precision to 1.0000 (ROC-AUC 0.8571).
